issues.issue: The proviso allows early reimbursement of 'unreimbursed Monthly Advances', a capitalized term the Agreement never defines; the operative sentence speaks instead of 'Advances' and 'other unreimbursed advances'.

The paragraph deems any non-compliance an Event of Default and declares that 'This paragraph shall supersede any other provision in this Agreement or any other agreement to the contrary', which cannot be squared with the Events of Default and cure provisions of Section 9.01.

The paragraph makes any Section 4.17 non-compliance an automatic Event of Default and says it 'shall supersede any other provision in this Agreement or any other agreement to the contrary', which collides with the Event of Default regime of Section 9.01 and with the identical superseding paragraphs in Sections 4.16 and 4.18.

Item (IV) requires a 'Sarbanes-Oxley Certification as described in Section 4.18(a)(ii)(D) below', but the Sarbanes-Oxley Certification is described in Section 4.18(a)(iii)(D); the cross-reference points to the Form 8-K subsection.

The opening sentence is broken — the parenthetical that should define the collective term 'Additional Disclosure' is never closed ('(collectively, the obligation to include such Additional Information in the applicable Exchange Act report is subject to receipt from ...')— so the defined term used throughout Section 4.18 has no definition.
The filing date is 'January 30th of the first year in which the Securities Administrator is able to do so under applicable law', a condition whose satisfaction is left to no one's determination.

The bar on reimbursement of the Securities Administrator's Section 4.18 fees from the Trust Fund sits against Section 4.18(a)(i)(B) and (a)(iii)(B), which make the Depositor responsible for such fees, and against the fee and expense provisions of Section 10.05.
The second indemnity runs only to 'the Depositor and each of its officers, directors and affiliates', dropping the Securities Administrator that the first sentence of the same paragraph protects.
Contribution is to be 'in such proportion as is appropriate to reflect the relative fault and the relative benefit of the respective parties', with no method for weighing fault against benefit.

The paragraph first deems any failure to comply with Section 4.18 an Event of Default requiring immediate termination, then provides that no Event of Default occurs where the failure results from another party's failure to deliver information, so the same paragraph both creates and negates the default.

It also declares that it 'shall supersede any other provision in this Agreement or any other agreement to the contrary', which cannot be reconciled with the Event of Default and termination scheme of Section 9.01.

The provision allows Section 4.18 to be amended 'Notwithstanding the provisions of Section 12.01' and without Certificateholder consent, which has to be squared with the amendment and consent machinery of Section 12.01.

Delivery of reports and notices by e-mail or telephone under this clause must be reconciled with the formal notice requirements of Section 12.05, to which the same Section 4.18 elsewhere refers for contact details.

Obligations are to be 'supplemented and modified as necessary to be consistent with ... convention or consensus among active participants in the asset-backed securities markets', a standard with no ascertainable content.
Clause (d) provides that 'no amendment of this Agreement shall be required' to change the parties' obligations, which cannot be reconciled with the amendment requirements of Section 12.01.

The option is granted to 'Saxon or the Majority Class CE Certificateholder', but the last sentence says 'This right may be assigned by the Seller to a third party', naming a party who holds no such right under the provision.

The Swap Account is here treated as subject to investment instructions given to the Securities Administrator, while the 'Swap Account' definition says it is created and maintained by the Swap Administrator under the Swap Administration Agreement.

This subsection establishes the Reserve Fund and its initial deposit, while the 'Reserve Fund' and 'Reserve Fund Deposit' definitions both say the fund is created and funded 'pursuant to Section 6.08 hereof'.
